hint_tuj_equipgundescription: Нажмите <action id="MountSlot2"/>, чтобы снарядить дополнительное оружие
hint_tut_ping-loot_description: Удерживайте <action id="Ping"/>, чтобы отметить добычу, которую нужно забрать.
hint_tut_ping-guard_description: Удерживайте <action id="Ping"/>, чтобы отметить охранника, которого нужно вырубить.
hint_tuj_escapedescription: Чтобы эвакуироваться, удерживайте <action id="Use"/> около любой передней двери фургона.
hint_tuj_ziptiedescription: Удерживайте <action id="Use"/>, чтобы связать обезвреженного человека.
hint_tuj_heisterswitchdescription: Удерживайте <action id="WheelMenu"/>, чтобы открыть меню персонажей. Отпустите, чтобы переключиться на выбранного персонажа.
hint_tuj_strikesdescription: Если вас заметели за подозрительным занятием, вы получите страйк. Более серьезных правонарушениях немедленно оповестят власти.
hint_tuj_picklockstartdescription: Перемещайте отмычку, пока не найдете нужное положение. Затем нажмите <action id="ShootPrimary"/>, чтобы зафиксировать штифт.
hint_tuj_destroycamerawithgundescription: Нажмите <action id="Bash"/>, чтобы сломать камеру оружием
hint_tuj_destroycasesdestriction: Нажмите <action id="Bash"/>, чтобы сломать кейсы с ценностями. Удерживайте <action id="Use"/>, чтобы забрать добычу.
hint_tut_stealthkilldescription: Будучи незамеченным, нажмите <action id="Bash"/> за спиной у врага, чтобы устранить его, не привлекая внимания
hint_tut_retrievelootdescription: Нажмите <action id="DropWieldable"/> рядом с кузовом фургона, чтобы закидывать туда сумки.
hint_tut_droppingdescription: Press <action id="DropWieldable"/> to drop the currently equipped object.
hint_tuj_jumpdescription: Press <action id="Jump"/> to jump or climb over obstacle.
hint_tuj_pingdescription: Press <action id="Ping"/> while looking at objects or enemies to mark them for your team.
hint_tuj_screamdescription: Press <action id="Shout"/> to intimidate civilians. Then zip tie them by holding <action id="Use"/>.
hint_tut_holsterdescription: Press <action id="SwitchHolsterWeapon"/> to holster the weapon.
hint_tuj_cameracontrollerdescription: Press <action id="Use"/> to take control of the security monitor. Then hold <action id="Use"/> to disable cameras.
hint_tut_subduedescription: Press <action id="Use"/> when behind somebody to subdue them.
hint_tuj_followalldescription1: Press <action id="WheelMenu"/> then press <action id="BotFollow"/> to have your teammates follow you.
meta_crew_promotion_text: Promotion increases health, improves combat abilities, adds or upgrades perks and gives new equipment.
hint_tuj_shootingdescription: Shooting your firearm in public without silencer will alert nearby enemies and trigger a response from law enforcement
hint_tuj_guardscream: Subdue and zip tie the guard
hint_tut_revives_count: The icon next to the healthbar shows available revives
hint_tut_cameradescription: Use <action id="Ability1"/> to take a picture
hint_tuj_followalldescription2: Use the 'Follow me' command to have everyone regroup on you.
hint_tuj_guardscreamdescription: You can subdue unsuspecting individuals by pressing <action id="Use"/> on them. Then hold <action id="Use"/> to zip tie them.

ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_PaG-1_description: A party on our turf and we weren't invited? Let's crash it and show Hielo's gangsters they're out of their depth.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_SA-3_description: A plan has been put together � sneak onto Khan's yacht and carry out his drug shipment. Be silent and effective.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_O13-1_description: A standard bank robbery is in play. Get the money and Mozart will pick you up.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_PH_description: A team of professional criminals. A relentless Sheriff. And a train full of money.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_CAG_description: A tech mogul seeks to control the city. Will a local gang be able to take on a dictator in the making?
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_PaG_description: After Hielo's goons party on a wrong turf, a bloody conflict ensues.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_O13_description: An access code for a hidden vault creates a perfect opportunity to fatten the pockets.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_TH_description: An esteemed family is moving to Rockay � with plenty of treasures to steal.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_GCL_description: An uneasy alliance between rivals is tested in a desperate hunt for King's gold.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_GCS_description: Can the crew get inside a federal depot and pull off the heist of the century?
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_AoH-2_description: Documents recovered in the repair shop indicate an armored truck's route. Intercept it, crack it open, rob it blind.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_TH-1_objective: Find information in the jewelry store
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_PaG-2_description: Hielo, pissed at our beach antics, took a shipment of our drugs. What he didn't expect is our knowledge of the stash's location.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_AoH_description: It's a new dawn in Rockay City as aspiring thieves get put under the veteran�s wing of Touchdown.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_O13-3_description: It's time for the big one. Step into the vault and get back with its contents.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_TH-2_description: Khan is also after the Dragon Dogs and following the jewelry store fiasco, he's coming with vengeance. Protect our stash warehouse.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_SA-1_description: Khan's convoy is heading for Baker's territory, armed to the teeth. He needs to be stopped.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_AoH-1_description: Khan, a prominent player in Rockay City, operates from a repair shop downtown. Let's pay them a surprise visit and see what they got for us.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_O13-2_description: Mozart was caught by police and is being transported. As he holds the vault's location, we have to free him.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_KillHielo_description: Party�s over; assist Mac against his former employer and hit Hielo where it hurts the most.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_TH-3_description: The Dragon Dogs are waiting for us, preparations are finished. Let's steal the antique treasures.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_SA-2_description: The target is a drug distribution center hidden in plain sight. Khan's guys won't know what hit them.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_TH-1_description: This jewelry store should hold information about the Zangs' possessions. Find it and get some pocket money in the process.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_random_hard_description: Three random mission with increased complexity.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_random_easy_description: Three simpler random missions of shorter length.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_PH-2_description: Time for a second truck. The police will be on their toes, so keep your eyes open.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_SA_description: To put a stop to Khan's advancements, his drug operation needs to be dismantled.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_PH-3_description: We acquired documents with the route of the Money Train. We stop it with a bomb, get the money and escape using a helicopter.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_PH-1_description: We got crucial information from our associate. A truck will be moving through the city � time to hit it.
ST_ChainMissions.schain_story_PaG-3_description: We struck a deal with Hielo to sell him back his diamonds. Meet his people at the canals.

ST_Changelog.update5:
Crosshair toggle option added to game options - you can now turn crosshair on or off.

New Multistore layout - a big store with 2 floors.

Perks overhaul - removing negative aspects for easier navigation.

Butcher appearing in Dollar Dragon�s turfs - a new elite enemy for Turfwar will appear in rougelite campaign now.

Teammate detail overhaul for better user experience.

New playable teammates for more variety in your gang.
ST_Changelog.update4_extend:
Notable changes in previous updates:

Difficulty tweaks of the Campaign and Urban Legends. 

Option to kick / mute players in FPS game was added to the pause menu. 

Playing missions in Crime Time changes respect. If you are winning, respect grows. With more respect, difficulty and reward gets higher. 

Big heists randomly pop up in Crime Time Map screen once you reach Connected respect level (up to 2 missions finished).

Shuffle mode available in Crime Time. Players can play solo or MP random mission chains in 3 difficulties.

New missions and locations (Gas station, Truck Convoy, Car Dealer).

Character missions persistency. Once you finish a character mission, you will resume the story even if you start campaign again.

Weapon pickup from ground in mission is possible now.
ST_Changelog.update7:
Revised onboarding for a streamlined, first-time user experience.

The new Quickjoin feature allows you to get straight into the action, along with improved multiplayer experience.

Difficulty settings now available for multiplayer.

Heat will rise more rapidly during daytime missions.

Equipment now has a cooldown rather than numbered charges. Players can purchase them along with weapons on the black market.
ST_Changelog.update4:
Tactical ping � bots can now be commanded using ping mechanics to do basic tasks at your will.

�Ready� status in multiplayer lobby is now more noticeable so players do not forget to confirm it.

Buyback of weapons in Crime Time is now possible. If you lose a weapon in a mission, the black market provides an option to buy it back.

Plotline selector. At this time, it is available for Gold Cup plotline only. Select which plotline you want to experience in your campaign run.
ST_Changelog.update6:
Winter-themed main menu and enemy gangsters wearing snowman heads

New female generic character models

New mission type � stealing the briefcase taking place at the police station

Quality-of-life tutorial update

Vehicles can now explode when you shoot the engine

ST_Codex.codex_entry_equipment_description:
<BigEm>EQUIPMENT</> is an additional tool you carry in missions which can trigger various effects. It ranges from throwable items like grenades, self-buffs for various stats to devices that disable electronics.

Each character carries a single piece of equipment you can use by pressing <action id="Ability1"/>. Holding the button with long-range gadgets displays a throw trajectory you can use to help you aim.

Equipment can typically be used again after its cooldown elapses, although certain items are instead recharged with enemy kills.
ST_Codex.codex_entry_health_description:
<BigEm>HEALTH</> represents the amount of damage a character can take and still continue fighting.

After taking damage, your health will start regenerating after a delay as long as you avoid further injuries.

When your health first drops to zero, you fall to the <Italic>downstate</>, and another member of your team must come to revive you � otherwise, you�ll soon die. This action will cost you one <BigEm>REVIVE</>. Every character has a certain number of revives, which can be further increased with perks.

If your health drops to zero and you have no revives left (or there�s nobody left to revive you), you will die. Certain sources of damage will kill you no matter what, such as falling from a great height.
ST_Codex.codex_entry_missions_description:
<BigEm>MISSIONS</> are the bread and butter of your operation. Assemble your team of up to four players to steal loot, dispose of enemies, sneak undetected or dish out heavy gunfire.

Successful missions are rewarded with cash and experience based on the final rating between one and three stars.
��The first star is given for a successful mission
��The second star comes from <Italic>clean execution</>; finishing without killing civilians or dead team members
� The third star is awarded for completing the optional bonus objective

If it seems your mission is going south, you can <Italic>restart</> it from the pause menu.
ST_Codex.codex_entry_perks_description:
<BigEm>PERKS</> are passive bonuses that improve your character�s default stats. They come in three tiers, but a character can equip each perk only once.

Every character comes with a default <Italic>class perk</>, which determines the base stats of a character, and up to three perks that offer further boosts.

Picking the correct set of perks for the situation can greatly affect your chances of completing a mission.

You can select and upgrade perks of the <Italic>Boss</>, while other characters come with a fixed set. Perks of campaign characters are added and upgraded during promotions.
ST_Codex.codex_entry_stealth_description:
<BigEm>STEALTH</> represents the initial phase of most missions in which you are hidden and attract no attention from police forces and gangsters alike.

Committing actions like taking down guards, breaking cameras, trespassing, or simply behaving suspiciously (running, jumping, crouching in the vicinity of guards) will give you a <BigEm>STRIKE</>. Accumulating three strikes fails stealth, the police are called, and the mission continues in combat.
Certain actions go beyond mere suspicion, and guards will call the police immediately after witnessing evidence of crimes. Examples include seeing weapons, hearing gunshots, finding trespassers in restricted areas or encountering dead bodies or stolen goods.

Once stealth is broken, the mission has to be finished in combat, with an increasingly strong police response.
ST_Codex.codex_entry_weapons_description:
Each character comes equipped with three <BigEm>WEAPONS</>.

<Italic>Primary weapon</> is your heavy hitter, best suited for the heat of combat.

<Italic>Secondary weapon</> is your supporting firearm, trading fire rate and damage for precision. When you carry�multiple loot bags, only this weapon can be used.

<Italic>Melee weapon</> can turn the flow of combat when you get surrounded by enemies at close range. Or when you prefer a stealthier approach.
ST_Codex.codex_entry_difficulty_description:
Missions can be started in three <BigEm>DIFFICULTIES</>. 

Higher difficulties bring a tougher challenge in exchange for increased reward.

In stealth, enemies become more perceptive and react faster. Pings have a limited duration and count. Civilians flee faster. More loot bags are needed to finish a mission.

Once combat breaks, enemies inflict more damage and become more aggressive. Your health and regeneration are slightly reduced. The police begin with more badges, which affects the enemy type and intensity of response.
ST_Codex.codex_entry_team_description:
No Boss can pull off a heist all alone.

Up to four characters can form a <BigEm>TEAM</> and participate on a mission. Team members can assist with their own unique approach, loadout and perks. They may revive fallen teammates and assist in coordinated actions. Having more human players increases the reward, but may also affect difficulty.
There are no penalties for taking bots, so it�s advisable to fill the free slots with the extra help, unless you fancy a�challenge.

Pressing <action id="WheelMenu"/> opens the <BigEm>CHAT WHEEL</> that you can use to�communicate with others. From there, you may also access the <BigEm>BOT WHEEL</> to command bots. When playing alone, you may <Italic>switch</> between any available bots and play as them.
ST_Codex.codex_entry_locks_description:
Not all valuables can be grabbed straight off the shelves. Truly valuable loot tends to be kept behind a slew of security measures.

Crates, display cases and the like can typically be broken into with <action id="Bash"/>.

Simple locked doors and containers can be <BigEm>LOCKPICKED</>. When lockpicking, turn the lock until the pins align with the middle point, and after aligning them all, the lock opens. Secure doors may instead require finding the access keycard or a keypad code.

When all else fails, few doors resists being drilled into or sawed through.
ST_Codex.codex_entry_cameras_description:
Off-limit locations are often monitored by <BigEm>CAMERAS</>. Crimes witnessed through them are reported to the authorities. As with guards, there is a brief grace period to act before a crime is reported; however, broken cameras raise suspicion and will cause a <Italic>strike</>.

Individual cameras can be temporarily disabled on the spot with specialized equipment.

The camera system is operated from the <Italic>security office</> via a <BigEm>SECURITY MONITOR</>, which can be used to inspect the surroundings through available cameras, or disable them all for good.
ST_Codex.codex_entry_ping_description:
Pressing <action id="Ping"/> <BigEm>HIGHLIGHTS</> an object you�re looking at for you and your teammates. You can use this to keep track of cameras and enemies (even as they walk behind obstacles) or point out places of interest.

Holding the button with bots on your team may be used to issue <BigEm>BOT COMMANDS</>. Different commands are available depending on the situation.
Bots may be ordered to <Icon>?</><Bold>Subdue</> enemies, <Icon>[</><Bold>Defend</> an area, <Icon>A</><Bold>Loot</> valuables and many more context-specific actions.
ST_Codex.codex_entry_crowdcontrol_description:
The key to a successful stealth approach is awareness of one�s surroundings, civilians and patrolling enemies.

<Italic>Civilians</> will flee to safety and report crimes they witness. You can <BigEm>INTIMIDATE</> one or multiple civilians with <action id="Shout"/>. Avoid harming civilians, as that fails <Italic>clean execution</> and lowers your overall mission reward.

Approaching patrolling enemies or civilians from the back before they notice you allows you to silently <BigEm>SUBDUE</> them.

Subdued or intimidated targets can be <BigEm>ZIP-TIED</> to prevent them from running away and moved to a more convenient location.
